faq.question: Who is Hasib Ahmad Bhuyan?
faq.answer: Hasib Ahmad Bhuyan is a Software Engineer specializing in scalable API platforms, distributed microservices, and production-grade Agentic AI systems. He is based in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh, and builds in Python (FastAPI, Django, Asyncio) and Go.

faq.question: What has Hasib built?
